about: Every native hook (detour) and in-place code patch that the Dungeon Settlers mod loader and its official mods put into GameAssembly. Generated from the sources by tools/hooks/hooklist.py; see the README section 'Hook list'.

fields.kind: detour (the first instructions jump to our code; the original stays callable) or patch (instruction bytes changed in place)
fields.method: Il2Cpp name of the hooked function as Il2CppDumper's script.json writes it (Namespace.Class$$Method); 'inside X+0xN' = an address inside that function; 'export X' = a GameAssembly export
fields.platforms: per platform: rva = offset in GameAssembly.dylib (mac-arm64) / GameAssembly.dll (win-x64); shared_with = other methods whose code starts at the same address (the hook sees their calls too); methods = every method at that address when the label names none of them; inside = the function around the address
fields.active: when the hook is installed: always = at game start whenever its owner is on; env X = only when that environment variable is set (test copies, debugging); other text = the condition in the source
fields.label: the name the loader log prints: '<label>: hooked <rva> for <owner>' (patches: 'patched')
fields.source: repo:file of the hook call (multiplayer, custom-modes: at the pinned commit mp_pin / cm_pin)
fields.patch: patch only: per platform the bytes expected (hex) and the bytes written; the loader refuses a patch when the bytes differ
fields.key: stable id of the hook site, used by the release gate (tools/hooks/hooklist.py check)
